root_cause: Live acceptance of T-0583 (2026-07-04) found a P0: POST /api/users hardcoded email=login when calling KeycloakUserPort.createHumanUser. A non-email login (the ordinary happy path — the UI placeholder hints email but never validated it) 400'd on a real Keycloak realm, which the port mapped to AUTH_UNAVAILABLE -> 503 'account service unavailable'. Between that finding and this task, T-0625 (already merged, an ancestor of this branch) closed the 503 a DIFFERENT way: it made `login` itself mandatory-email-shaped (client+server EMAIL_RE validation before any KC call) and added employee.login (migration 126) so GET /api/users/accounts shows the real login instead of the KC user UUID (that second bug from T-0628's own ticket was therefore ALREADY closed and left untouched). T-0625's contract is narrower than this task's own spec: T-0628 requires login to stay FREE-FORM (a non-email username like ivan.petrov is legitimate) with email as its OWN required field, validated on our side before any KC call.

fix_summary.server_validation: src/http/user-mgmt.ts validateCreateBody: removed the EMAIL_RE requirement on `login` (now only requires non-empty), added `email` as a new required field validated with the same EMAIL_RE, BEFORE any kc.createHumanUser call. kc.createHumanUser now receives {username: login, email} as two DISTINCT values (previously {username: login, email: login} — same string duplicated).
fix_summary.schema: migrations/127_employee_email.sql adds choros.employee.email (nullable text, additive ADD COLUMN, mirrors 125_employee_deactivated_at.sql / 126_employee_login.sql style) — stored separately from employee.login (126) and employee.slug (the KC user UUID, 016).
fix_summary.port_and_fake: src/keycloak/admin-port.ts: KcHumanUserSpec doc-comments updated (username is free-form, distinct from email); the EMAIL_INVALID defense-in-depth branch now documents it guards `email`, not `username`. src/keycloak/fake-user-port.ts: the T-0625 fake-fidelity check previously required BOTH spec.username and spec.email to be email-shaped (mirroring this codebase's own prior choice, not a real Keycloak constraint — verified config/keycloak/realm-choros.json sets no registrationEmailAsUsername/email-only flag); now validates ONLY spec.email, matching the live port and a real KC realm.

fix_summary.users_screen_gate_minor: T-0628's minor item (/users reachable by direct URL for a non-owner; nav hides it but the page rendered unrestricted) is addressed by mirroring the ONLY existing degrade pattern in this codebase (screen-org.jsx OrgTree: canWrite derived from the status of an already-gated GET). screen-users.jsx already calls GET /api/org/tenant-state (for the position dropdown) — its 200/403 status now also drives a new `canWrite` state: 200 -> full write controls, 403/other -> 'Создать учётку' button and per-row Деактивировать/Реактивировать hidden, replaced by an explanatory banner. This is a COSMETIC client-side degrade only — the real gate stays server-side (POST/PATCH /api/users 403 via assertOrgObjectAuthority, T-0469, unchanged).
